featured.title: Telminder
featured.description: Tracks Telkom University coursework deadlines. Moodle there offers no API token and no “submitted” flag, so Telminder infers overdue and submitted work from the history it stores. Its first run found eight overdue assignments, two still submittable.

featured.title: naohr-lab
featured.description: An old laptop turned home server, with no open ports and reachable only over Tailscale. Public services will go out through a Cloudflare Tunnel on *.naohr.site, on the same Cloudflare account that serves this site.
